name: Zara'thul
source:
Affiliation: Dragon Volk (Queen)
Location: Idris, Council Space
Relationship: Well Bred Queen
Personnel File: Zara'Thul is the Queen and Leader of the recently encountered Dragon Volk. She has led them through tragedy, and now seeks to ensure their future.
Strengths: Leadership, Ferocious Loyalty, Diplomacy, Self Sacrifice.
Weaknesses: Almost no tech knowledge, Poor at combat, Trusting, Perpetually Horny
Note Inserted in file: Idris will play an interesting role in Solar Alliance policy moving forward. Disperse relevant personnel to infiltrate rebuilding efforts.
